summary: A recently released AMD SCSIAdapter 9.3.0.221 driver update is causing Windows 10 PCs to crash with a "INACCESSIBLE_BOOT_DEVICE" Blue Screen of Death error. Microsoft has reportedly pulled the problematic driver from Windows Update, though some users on production builds may have already received it. Users are advised to block the update or rollback the driver if already installed.

title: Chaos means cash for criminals and cybersecurity companies
summary: The article analyzes the booming cybersecurity market, driven by increased cybercrime sophistication and chaotic responses from companies. It highlights key trends including the rise of ransomware-as-a-service, island-hopping attacks, and the fragmented but lucrative cybersecurity landscape. The author also discusses the importance of identity management, with a specific focus on Okta's strategic acquisition of Auth0 to expand its market dominance.

title: Select Interior Concepts to Sell Its RDS Segment to Interior Logic Group for $215 Million
summary: Select Interior Concepts (SIC) announced a definitive agreement to sell its Residential Design Services (RDS) segment to Interior Logic Group (ILG) for approximately $215 million in an all-cash transaction. This sale aims to transform SIC's balance sheet to a debt-free, strong net cash position, providing significant financial flexibility. The company plans to concentrate its efforts on maximizing value in the stone and tile distribution market through its Architectural Surfaces Group segment, expecting to improve its total margin profile and reduce capital expenditure requirements.

title: Amex pushing beyond cards to woo small businesses
summary: American Express is expanding its services beyond traditional payment cards to better serve small and midsize businesses, a crucial segment accounting for a significant portion of its loan mix and card member receivables. The company is offering a range of supplier payment and cash-flow management solutions, including its One AP automation platform and Kabbage for lending and working capital, aiming to deepen relationships with existing clients and attract new ones. This move reflects a broader industry trend towards B2B solutions, with Amex leveraging its closed-loop system and bank charter to differentiate itself from competitors like Visa and Mastercard.

title: WalkMe digital adoption platform eases application overload
summary: Digital adoption platforms (DAPs) like WalkMe are becoming crucial as companies invest heavily in enterprise applications, leading to "Franken-stacks" that overwhelm employees. A Harvard Business Review Analytic Services report highlights that most employees interact with multiple digital touchpoints daily but often lack high digital aptitude. WalkMe aims to solve this by guiding users through applications and collecting usage data, improving productivity and reducing support tickets, as demonstrated by CrossCountry Mortgage LLC.

title: Intel Launches New 11th Gen Core for Mobile
summary: Intel Corporation (INTC) announced the global launch of its 11th Generation Intel Core H-series mobile processors, code-named "Tiger Lake-H," on May 11, 2021. The flagship Intel Core i9-11980HK, based on 10nm SuperFin process technology, delivers speeds up to 5.0GHz, offering industry-leading mobile performance for gaming, content creation, and business professionals with up to eight cores and 16 threads, and PCIe Gen 4 support. The release also includes new Intel vPro H-series and Intel Xeon W-11000 series mobile processors, powering over 80 enthusiast laptop designs this year.

title: Gartner names Microsoft a Leader in the 2021 Endpoint Protection Platforms Magic Quadrant
summary: Microsoft has been recognized as a Leader in the 2021 Endpoint Protection Platforms Magic Quadrant by Gartner, positioned highest on the ability to execute. This recognition highlights Microsoft's commitment to evolving its endpoint security solutions to meet the challenges faced by customers, including adapting to hybrid work and sophisticated threats. The article details the innovations in Microsoft Defender, such as advanced malware protection, security for all devices, and unified management through Microsoft 365 Defender, emphasizing its comprehensive XDR capabilities.

title: AWS, HPE, Other IT Vendors Back $50B Call For U.S. Chip Production
summary: A coalition including major IT vendors like AWS, HPE, Apple, and Microsoft is advocating for $50 billion in U.S. government funding for domestic semiconductor manufacturing and research. This initiative, part of the CHIPS for America Act, aims to address the decline in U.S. chip production share and bolster supply chain resiliency. While supporting the funding, the group advised against government intervention in the current chip shortage and urged careful allocation of funds to benefit the entire industry rather than individual companies.

title: ServiceNow Continues Vertical Industry Push With OT Management Solution For Manufacturing
summary: ServiceNow is expanding its vertical industry strategy by introducing its first software tailored for the manufacturing sector. The new Operational Technology (OT) Management solution integrates IT and OT systems to enhance efficiency, reduce downtime, and improve security within manufacturing environments, leveraging the core Now Platform. This initiative aims to address the automation needs of "Industry 4.0" and create new opportunities for its ISV and systems integration partners.

title: 7 ESG Stocks That Could Come Under Fire if the SEC Gets Its Way
summary: The SEC is increasing its scrutiny of ESG (environmental, social, and governance) claims and reporting, which could lead to increased regulations and potentially impact the performance of several ESG-focused stocks and ETFs. This article highlights seven such entities, including the SPDR S&P 500 ESG ETF, Beyond Meat, Tesla, and Microsoft, explaining why they might face challenges under heightened regulatory oversight. The author notes that stricter reporting standards could reveal weaknesses or question the current "ESG-friendly" positioning of these companies.

title: The New Ransomware Threat: Triple Extortion
summary: Ransomware attacks have significantly increased globally, with a 102% rise compared to early 2020. Industries such as healthcare and utilities are prime targets, with Asia Pacific experiencing the highest volume of attacks. Check Point Research details a new "Triple Extortion" model where attackers not only encrypt data and threaten publication but also launch DDoS attacks and contact third parties like business partners and media for increased pressure, as seen with the REvil group.

title: Mars and Microsoft work together to accelerate Mars' digital transformation and reimagine business operations, Associate experience and consumer engagement
summary: Mars and Microsoft are expanding their long-term relationship with a new agreement to accelerate Mars' digital transformation using Microsoft Azure. This partnership aims to optimize Mars' operational speed, enhance intelligent manufacturing supply chains, and digitally empower its global confectionery, petcare, pet services, and food businesses. The collaboration will also focus on sustainable practices, digital skills training for Associates, and developing an Innovation Lab to drive new solutions and enhance employee productivity.

title: Infosys Collaborates with RXR Realty to Develop a Smart Office Platform Running on Microsoft Azure for Safe Return to Work
summary: Infosys has partnered with RXR Realty to develop RxWell, an award-winning smart building, health, and wellness solution operating on Microsoft Azure. This platform is designed to assist in the safe return to work following COVID-19 by providing insights and management tools for property managers, tenant administrators, and office workers. Currently deployed in 26 New York City office buildings, RxWell helps ensure adherence to safety protocols and will be expanded to include energy efficiency and predictive maintenance features.

title: Brookfield sells US$13-billion in assets in first quarter as CEO calls for ‘harvesting’
summary: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. sold US$13-billion in assets during the first quarter, generating a gain of over US$6.4-billion and exceeding analyst profit expectations. CEO Bruce Flatt described this period as "harvesting" due to robust capital markets, particularly in developed regions. The company is now looking for new investment opportunities outside North America and in pandemic-distressed sectors, including an attempt to privatize Brookfield Property Partners LP.

title: Automating the IT Help Desk: A Win for Employee Experience & Cost Reduction
summary: The article discusses how automating IT help desks can significantly improve employee experience and reduce operational costs, especially in the context of increased remote work. It explores intelligent automation (IA) technologies like cognitive automation, virtual agents, and unattended automation to streamline common IT support tasks such as ticketing, password resets, and software provisioning. By implementing these solutions, companies can decrease turnaround times, mitigate the financial impact of unresolved IT issues, and free up IT staff for more complex tasks.

title: Elasticsearch on Azure: A Quick Start Guide
summary: This guide provides a quick start for deploying Elasticsearch on Azure using Elastic Stack's automated deployment template. It covers the reference architecture, a step-by-step setup process through the Azure Marketplace, and addresses common questions regarding cost and connectivity. The article also mentions NetApp Cloud Volumes ONTAP as a solution for optimizing Elasticsearch deployments on Azure.

title: Amdocs Acquires Sourced to Further Boost Communications Industry’s Move to the Cloud
summary: Amdocs has acquired Sourced Group, a leading global technology consultancy, to enhance its capabilities in helping the communications industry transition to the cloud. This acquisition expands Amdocs’ portfolio of cloud-native products and services, leveraging Sourced’s decade of experience in large-scale cloud transformations for high-end enterprises. The deal, valued at approximately $75 million in cash, is expected to be neutral to Amdocs' non-GAAP diluted earnings per share for fiscal year 2021.

title: Elasticsearch on AWS: Deploying Your First Managed Cluster
summary: This article explains how to deploy a managed Elasticsearch cluster on Amazon Web Services (AWS) using Amazon's managed Elasticsearch Service (Amazon ES). It covers the key features of Amazon ES, a step-by-step guide to creating a new domain, and methods for ingesting and searching data. Additionally, it addresses how Amazon ES manages various administrative tasks and its compatibility with open-source Elasticsearch APIs.

title: monday.com files for Nasdaq IPO
summary: monday.com, an Israeli work operating system company, has filed a prospectus for an IPO on Nasdaq. The company, previously valued at $2.7 billion in a secondary transaction, aims to raise an initial $100 million and will trade under the ticker MNDY. This IPO follows a trend of Israeli companies going public on Wall Street, with monday.com reporting $161 million in revenue for 2020 and a net loss of $152 million.

title: Apple Inc. stock falls Tuesday, underperforms market
summary: Apple Inc. (AAPL) stock fell 1.12% on Tuesday, closing at $124.85, amidst a broader market downturn with the NASDAQ Composite and Dow Jones Industrial Average also declining. This marked the stock's second consecutive day of losses, placing it $20.24 below its 52-week high. The article also notes Apple's performance compared to competitors like Microsoft, Alphabet, and IBM, all of which also experienced declines.

title: HPE bets on Europe’s Gaia-X cloud and data services initiative
summary: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) is launching its HPE Solution Framework for Gaia-X, aligning with Europe's initiative to create a unified, data-privacy-protected cloud and data services ecosystem. Gaia-X aims to reduce Europe's reliance on non-European cloud providers by fostering an interoperable data exchange governed by European laws. HPE's framework, built on the HPE Ezmeral Software Platform, will help companies participate in this decentralized environment, emphasizing secure data operations and allowing businesses to maintain ownership and control over their data.

title: The Dangers of Double Extortion Ransomware Attacks
summary: This article explains "double extortion" ransomware attacks, a growing trend where cybercriminals not only encrypt data but also exfiltrate it, threatening to leak or sell it if the ransom isn't paid. It highlights the shift from traditional ransomware to this new tactic, making data backups less effective. The article also provides a real-world example of such an attack detected by Darktrace, emphasizing the need for proactive cybersecurity measures.

title: Don't download this Microsoft Authenticator extension for Chrome: it is fake
summary: A fake "Microsoft Authenticator" extension has been found in the Chrome Web Store, deceptively named and offered by "Extensions" rather than Microsoft. The extension, which had over 400 users, redirects to a Polish webpage asking for sign-in or account creation. Users are advised to verify the developer and details of any extension before installation, as official Microsoft Authenticator is only available as a mobile or Microsoft Store application, not a browser extension.

title: Alphabet was the most widely held stock for the largest ESG funds. Here’s what else they own
summary: Alphabet (Google's parent company) was the most widely held stock among the 20 largest ESG equity funds in 2020, with an average weight of 1.9%. Technology companies, including Apple and Microsoft, dominated the portfolios of these funds, accounting for the largest allocation in most, leading to their outperformance in a year where tech rallied and energy declined. While tech firms like Alphabet were favored due to meeting ESG criteria, the study also revealed holdings in other sectors, including specific energy companies and utilities, with their carbon intensity evaluated on a stock-by-stock basis.

title: 6 tips for better digital learning in the workplace
summary: The article provides six tips for improving digital learning in the workplace, emphasizing the need for flexible learning paths, opportunities for soft skill development, consumer-like learning experiences, increased engagement through gamification, exploration of VR and AR, and a purpose-driven strategy. These strategies aim to help companies upskill and reskill their workforces in the rapidly evolving corporate training landscape.

title: Microsoft's new Latin America president takes over following legal battle with IBM
summary: Rodrigo Kede Lima has officially started his new role as Microsoft's president for Latin America and corporate Vice President, a year after his appointment. His start was delayed due to a legal battle with his former employer IBM, which sued him for breaching a non-compete agreement upon his move to Microsoft. A New York federal court ruled in favor of IBM, preventing Kede Lima from beginning his position until May 18, 2021.

title: Fake Microsoft Authenticator extension discovered in Chrome Store
summary: A fake Microsoft Authenticator extension was discovered in the Chrome Web Store, successfully duping hundreds of users into downloading it despite clear red flags in its details and reviews. The bogus extension, available since April 23, 2021, redirected users to a Polish webpage asking for sign-in or account creation and offered no legitimate authentication functionality. Google has since removed the extension, but concerns remain about potential sensitive information shared by the 448 affected users.

title: Microsoft gains approval for data center in Hoffman Estates, Illinois
summary: Microsoft has received approval to build the first of two planned data centers in Hoffman Estates, Illinois. The company is still working with ComEd to secure adequate power supply for the full build-out, as current infrastructure only supports 60 percent of the first building's capacity, requiring a proposed on-site substation. This development follows Microsoft's acquisition of the 53-acre former AT&T campus in June 2020.

title: Lo que necesitas saber para empezar a vender por redes sociales
summary: This article from Bancolombia provides a comprehensive guide for businesses looking to start selling on social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp. It outlines the benefits of having a digital presence, offers a 5-step process for establishing business accounts on Facebook and Instagram, and highlights the features of WhatsApp Business for growth. The guide emphasizes content creation, audience interaction, sales opportunities, and performance measurement using platform analytics.

title: Bill Gates has transferred John Deere shares worth $850 million to Melinda, bringing the total of stock handover to $3 billion since their divorce announcement. (And, it's just the beginning)
summary: Bill Gates has transferred an additional $850 million worth of shares in Deere & Co. to Melinda Gates, bringing the total value of stock transfers since their divorce announcement to $3 billion. This recent transfer includes 2.25 million shares of the farm equipment manufacturer. Following this, Bill Gates's stake in Deere dropped to 9.3%.

title: Vistria Group, Large Hospice Companies Invest in Muse Healthcare, Medalogix
summary: The Vistria Group, along with home health and hospice providers LHC Group, Amedisys, and Encompass Health, has invested in and recapitalized post-acute data analytics companies Muse Healthcare and Medalogix. Following the investment, the two companies will merge under the Medalogix brand, aiming to develop machine learning solutions to identify patients needing home health, hospice, or palliative care earlier and assist in care coordination. This initiative seeks to improve patient outcomes by ensuring care is provided in the home and addressing the issue of short hospice lengths of stay.

title: Where and how to buy Alphabet (GOOGL) stock
summary: This guide provides a comprehensive overview for newcomers interested in buying Alphabet (GOOGL) stock. It covers essential steps such as choosing a trading platform, funding an account, deciding investment amounts, and differentiating between buying shares or ETFs. The article also explains various order types and the importance of monitoring GOOGL's performance.

title: Rodrigo Kede Lima joins Microsoft Latin America as the new President for the region and Corporate Vice President at Microsoft Corporation
summary: Microsoft has announced Rodrigo Kede Lima as the new President for Latin America and Corporate Vice President at Microsoft Corporation. Lima's primary focus will be to support and accelerate digital transformation across Latin America by promoting cloud services and AI adoption, while also enabling Microsoft's customers to achieve business growth. He aims to build on Microsoft's legacy in the region by prioritizing customer needs, fostering strong partner relationships, and emphasizing the positive impact of technology and trust.

title: ServiceNow doubles down on cybersecurity with expanded Microsoft alliance
summary: ServiceNow announced new integrations with Microsoft products at its Knowledge 2021 virtual conference, aimed at enhancing cybersecurity operations for enterprises. These integrations include automating incident response workflows with Microsoft Teams and SharePoint, linking to Microsoft’s Threat Vulnerability Management tool for identifying urgent issues, and integrating with Azure Sentinel. The updates extend ServiceNow’s cybersecurity capabilities by streamlining administrative tasks and providing a central hub for managing technology operations.

title: Vimeo Unveils New Corporate Video Library To Keep Teams Connected
summary: Vimeo has introduced Video Library, a new centralized and secure hub designed to simplify video creation, communication, and collaboration for enterprise teams, particularly in distributed work environments. This platform aims to address the challenges of fragmented information and improve knowledge sharing through easily searchable and organized video content. Video Library is available to all Vimeo Enterprise customers and further solidifies Vimeo's position in the growing video SaaS market.

title: GUESS Europe launches the Guess Z Lab, in collaboration with the Lifestyle-Tech Competence Center and Microsoft
summary: GUESS Europe, in collaboration with the Lifestyle-Tech Competence Center (LTCC) and Microsoft, has launched the GUESS Z Lab. This innovative initiative aims to engage with Gen Z consumers through workshops and co-creation efforts, with the first workshop held at GUESS Europe HQ involving students from Ticino universities. The project seeks to gain insights from young consumers while also providing them with exposure to the fashion industry and brand building, with plans for international expansion and a digital insight platform in 2022.

title: In Focus: Robotic Floor Scrubbers
summary: The article discusses the rapid adoption of robotic floor scrubbers, driven by rising labor costs, health concerns, and limited resources. It highlights technological advancements in AI and navigation systems that have made these robots more efficient and affordable, leading to their widespread deployment in various sectors like retail, healthcare, and education. Companies like Brain Corp., Tennant Company, Avidbots, and ICE Robotics are key players in this growing market, emphasizing the benefits of labor reallocation, consistency, and measurable cleaning outcomes.

title: Amdocs beefs up BT business continuity for mobile customers
summary: Amdocs has expanded its multiyear managed services agreement with BT, deploying a joint solution with Lightico to enhance business continuity for BT’s mobile customers. This platform enables remote completion of sales journeys and contract signing, eliminating the need for physical paperwork or store visits. The initiative aims to improve efficiency, compliance, and customer experience, aligning with the shift towards digital interactions.

title: Coca-Cola Bottling Company Streamlines Operations with RPA
summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United partnered with Happiest Minds to implement Robotic Process Automation (RPA) using Microsoft Power Automate, streamlining its order management processes. This digital transformation addressed challenges with legacy applications and third-party websites, leading to significant cost savings and increased efficiency. The "Asa" master automated service agent, built on Microsoft Azure, allowed the company to avoid hiring 10 full-time employees and enabled existing CRM agents to focus on other projects.

title: ServiceNow Delivers New Security Integrations with Microsoft to Help Organizations Stay Protected and Resilient in the Hybrid Era of Work
summary: ServiceNow announced new strategic Security Operations-focused integrations with Microsoft to help organizations combat cyberattacks in the hybrid work era. These integrations, including with Microsoft Azure Sentinel, Threat & Vulnerability Management, Teams, and SharePoint, aim to enhance security planning, management, and incident response. The partnership leverages ServiceNow's platform to break down silos and automate workflows, enabling security teams to prioritize and act on security incidents more efficiently.

title: Schlumberger Announces Collaboration with AWS to Deploy DELFI Petrotechnical Suite on AWS
summary: Schlumberger announced a collaboration with Amazon Web Services (AWS) to deploy its DELFI* cognitive E&P environment and core petrotechnical applications on the cloud. This partnership will give AWS customers access to Schlumberger's AI-enhanced applications and AWS's high-performance computing infrastructure, enabling faster and better decision-making from subsurface data. The goal is to expand access to the DELFI environment, allowing more customers to leverage advanced digital solutions for improved productivity and performance in the energy sector.

title: Atlanta-based Acuity Brands names Peter Han President of Intelligent Spaces Group
summary: Acuity Brands, Inc. announced Peter Han, co-founder of Rockpile Ventures, as President of its newly-named Intelligent Spaces Group (ISG). The company also acquired Rockpile Ventures, a Seattle-based accelerator of AI companies, and appointed Rockpile co-founder Dinesh Narayanan as Vice President of Business Development of ISG. This move aims to bolster Acuity's growth in solutions, software, and cloud application development, leveraging Han's 25 years of experience in the technology industry to integrate AI with Acuity's existing infrastructure.

title: Microsoft’s Cloud Supply Chain blockchain initiative receives top award from Gartner for Supply Chain Breakthrough of the Year
summary: Microsoft's cloud supply chain blockchain initiative has won Gartner's Power of the Profession Award, including the top honor for Supply Chain Breakthrough of the Year and Process or Technology Innovation of the Year. The blockchain program, launched in November 2020, aims to digitize and financialize inventory assets, improve traceability, and resolve supply chain challenges. This initiative integrates ERP systems with blockchain for enhanced financial controls, compliance, and n-tier supply chain visibility, with plans to expand to more suppliers and address humanitarian issues like conflict minerals.

title: Philly employers wrestle with the pros and cons of bringing people back to the office
summary: As COVID-19 restrictions lift and vaccines become widely available, Philadelphia-area businesses are grappling with how and whether to bring employees back to the office. The article explores varied approaches, from a full return with flexible options at FMC to a hybrid model at Kleinbard LLC, and a fully remote setup at Horsey, Buckner & Heffler LLP. The debate weighs the benefits of in-person collaboration against the productivity gains and employee preference for remote work, while also considering the economic impact on downtown areas if offices remain vacant.

title: Edge computing: Powering the future of manufacturing
summary: Edge computing is becoming crucial for the manufacturing sector as it transitions into the fourth industrial revolution with smart factories and advanced automation. This technology addresses the limitations of traditional cloud infrastructure by processing data closer to its source, which reduces latency, bandwidth usage, and costs. Industry experts predict significant adoption of edge computing in manufacturing to enhance efficiency, quality control, and real-time decision-making.

title: Oracle debuts its first Arm-based cloud instances
summary: Oracle has launched its first Arm-based cloud instances, OCI Ampere A1 Compute, offering customers more flexibility and high performance at lower costs for general-purpose and cloud-native workloads. This move signifies Oracle's increased investment in the Arm ecosystem, providing a compelling alternative to x86-based instances and competing with rival cloud providers by offering attractive pricing and scaling options. The company is also expanding developer resources and tools to encourage Arm-based application development on its cloud platform, including free tier offerings and a new development stack.

title: Oracle Boasted That Its Software Was Used Against U.S. Protesters. Then It Took the Tech to China.
summary: Oracle promoted its Endeca software, initially developed with CIA backing and used by the Chicago Police Department to monitor U.S. protesters during the 2012 NATO summit, to Chinese authorities for surveillance purposes. This included marketing the software for "predictive policing" and social media mining in China, a move that critics argue contradicts U.S. intelligence interests and civil liberties protections. The article highlights concerns about big tech companies like Oracle entering the policing space and selling invasive surveillance tools globally after testing them domestically.

title: Flex manufactures everything from hair dryers to the Mac Pro — what’s next?
summary: This article features an interview with Flex CEO Revathi Advaithi, discussing the company's diverse manufacturing operations from consumer electronics to autonomous driving systems, and the complex interplay of politics, automation, and global supply chains. Advaithi also addresses the ongoing chip shortage, the future of manufacturing in the US, and Flex's commitment to sustainability. She highlights the company's shift towards investing in healthcare and automotive sectors due to technological changes.

title: Wiz raises $120 million from Salesforce and Blackstone
summary: Israeli cybersecurity company Wiz has raised $120 million from Salesforce and Blackstone, with its valuation expected to surpass $1.7 billion. This round included a significant secondary element, allowing early investor Gili Raanan to sell half his holdings for a 22x return. This also marks Blackstone's first investment in an Israeli company through its new growth fund, BXG.

title: Why to Go Big on Blue Chip Stock ETFs, R&D Potential
summary: The article highlights the T. Rowe Price Blue Chip Growth ETF (TCHP) as a favorable active management option for growth investors, particularly those interested in companies with significant research and development (R&D) expenditures. It emphasizes that while growth stocks are typically known for capital appreciation and high earnings, successful growth companies must continuously innovate and reinvest. TCHP, with its heavy allocation to tech stocks like Apple, Microsoft, and Amazon, offers exposure to companies that are dedicated R&D spenders, leveraging financial resources for market dominance and new revenue streams.

title: Dow uses vision AI at the edge to boost employee safety and security with Azure
summary: Dow's Digital Operations Center developed an AI and IoT solution using Microsoft Azure Video Analyzer and other Azure services to detect containment leaks and enhance employee safety. This sophisticated, flexible, and scalable solution for edge-based vision AI can be adapted for other safety scenarios such as PPE detection and entrance gate monitoring. The technology will help Dow achieve its goal of zero safety-related incidents.

title: Microsoft teams up with Accenture and Goldman Sachs to create energy efficient software
summary: Microsoft, Accenture, and Goldman Sachs, along with other organizations, are forming the Green Software Foundation to develop and share methods for creating software that produces fewer carbon emissions in data centers. Data centers currently account for about 1% of global electricity demand, projected to rise significantly, prompting the need for "green software engineering" skills. The foundation aims to build tools, establish standards for measuring software's climate impact, and provide training for engineers.

title: SailPoint Welcomes Wendy Wu as Chief Marketing Officer
summary: SailPoint Technologies Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of Wendy Wu as Chief Marketing Officer to support its continued growth and accelerated pivot towards SaaS. Wu brings over 20 years of B2B enterprise marketing experience from companies like Box, Google, and Microsoft. Her role will focus on driving brand awareness and business growth for the SailPoint Identity Platform worldwide, especially as enterprises recognize identity security's importance for digital transformation.

title: SailPoint Appoints Wendy Wu as Chief Marketing Officer
summary: SailPoint Technologies Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of Wendy Wu as Chief Marketing Officer to support its continued growth and SaaS transition. Wu brings over 20 years of experience in B2B enterprise marketing from companies like Box, Google, and Microsoft. She will focus on accelerating SailPoint's brand and market position, emphasizing identity security as a crucial component for digital transformation.

title: ‘Passing of torch’ in quantum computing race as Toronto’s Xanadu raises $100-million from Bessemer, CIA, Jeff Skoll
summary: Toronto-based Xanadu Quantum Technologies Inc. has secured US$100-million in funding, led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with additional investment from notable entities including Jeff Skoll’s Capricorn Investment Group, Tiger Global, and the CIA’s venture arm, In-Q-Tel. This significant investment positions Xanadu as a frontrunner in a new generation of quantum computing, challenging previous industry leaders like D-Wave Systems. The company aims to develop powerful quantum computers using light-based technology operating at room temperature, with a goal of scaling to one million qubits through networked chips accessible via the internet.

title: Future Looks Bright for Cloud Technology Degree
summary: Wake Tech's Cloud Infrastructure Associate in Applied Science (AAS) degree program is seeing high demand due to the increasing adoption of cloud technology by companies. The program prepares students for IT jobs in the Raleigh area, offering skills and credentials that align with industry needs, including hands-on experience in a unique Student Data Center. Graduates can expect a median salary of $85,000 and benefit from transfer partnerships for further education.

title: Microsoft builds distributed ledger for Azure SQL database
summary: Microsoft has introduced new capabilities to its Azure cloud database portfolio, including a distributed ledger for Azure SQL, a serverless offering for Azure Cosmos DB, and enhanced security for Azure Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL. The Azure SQL distributed ledger aims to provide blockchain-like functionality for tamper-evident logging without the complexity of traditional blockchain. These updates were announced at the Microsoft Build virtual conference, focusing on improved security, scalability, and ease of use for enterprise developers.

title: Internet Banking Market Likely To Boost Future Growth By 2026 |
summary: A new report on the Global Internet Banking Market provides a comprehensive 360-degree view of customer activities, segment-based analytics, and future outlook to 2026. The study by HTF Market Intelligence Consulting Pvt. Ltd. identifies growth drivers, disruptive trends, and R&D efforts by key competitors, including Microsoft, Tata Consultancy Services, Oracle, and Fiserv. The market is segmented by applications like Payments and Risk Management, and types such as Retail banking and Corporate banking, with regional analysis covering North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, South America, and MEA.

title: Microsoft brings 'quake mode' to Windows Terminal
summary: Microsoft has released a new preview version of its Windows Terminal, introducing a "quake mode" feature that allows users to quickly open a terminal instance from anywhere in Windows with a keyboard shortcut. This update also makes Windows Terminal the default emulator for command-line applications and includes an italic version of its Cascadia Code font, with Arabic and Hebrew characters planned for future release. The release also brings Fluent design elements to Task Manager and bug fixes for Windows 10 Insider Preview Build 21390.

title: Marvell Introduces Bravera SSD Controllers to Enable the Highest Performing Data Center Flash Storage Solutions
summary: Marvell has unveiled its new Bravera SC5 SSD controller family, which are the industry's first PCIe 5.0 SSD controllers. These controllers are designed to offer unprecedented performance, efficiency, and security for cloud data center workloads, boasting double the performance of PCIe 4.0 SSDs. They also include features like FIPS-compliant root of trust, AES 256-bit encryption, and a hardware-based Elastic SLA Enforcer to ensure quality of service and optimized resource utilization for hyperscale cloud providers.

title: S&P 500 trading guide: constituents, market hours and h
summary: This guide provides an in-depth look at the S&P 500, a key benchmark for U.S. stock market performance. It covers the index's constituents, listing criteria, calculation methods, factors affecting its price, and average annual returns. The article also details various ways to trade the S&P 500, including CFDs, futures, options, and ETFs, and discusses strategies for shorting the index.

title: Docker Honeypot Reveals Cryptojacking as Most Common Cloud Threat
summary: Palo Alto Networks' Unit 42 deployed a honeypot mimicking a misconfigured Docker daemon to observe cloud-related threats between March and April 2021. The research found that over 75% of the 850 attacks recorded were cryptojacking, with Kinsing being the most prevalent malware. Attackers exploit misconfigured Docker daemons to gain full control, deploy malicious containers, and often escalate privileges to the host system.

title: 3 ways HR can support women in the workplace
summary: This article discusses three ways Human Resources can support women in the workplace, focusing on gender diversity and inclusion. Samantha Rist, VP of People at Ekata, highlights the need to understand challenges women face in balancing work and family, address the persistent gender pay gap through equity reviews, and ensure women apply to and are fairly considered for job opportunities to improve diversity. The piece emphasizes that HR's efforts can significantly impact gender equality and overall employee experience.

title: Electronic Arts Inc. stock remains steady Friday, underperforms market
summary: Electronic Arts Inc. (EA) stock remained unchanged on Friday despite an overall strong market performance, with the S&P 500 and Dow Jones Industrial Average both seeing gains. The stock closed below its 52-week high and showed mixed performance compared to competitors like Microsoft Corp. (MSFT) and Walt Disney Co. (DIS). Trading volume was also below its 50-day average.

title: Microsoft Gold Partner, Mannai Corporation launches dedicated unit to accelerate digital transformation across Qatar
summary: Mannai Corporation, a Microsoft Gold partner, has established a new division dedicated to Microsoft solutions to accelerate cloud technology adoption across Qatar, aligning with the National Vision 2030. This move anticipates the launch of Microsoft's new Qatar cloud region, with IDC projecting a significant increase in public cloud service spending in the region. The new division comprises over 90 skilled professionals aiming to assist public and private sectors in their digital transformation journeys.

title: Yes, You Can Invest in a Tech-Less Nasdaq-100
summary: The article discusses the First Trust NASDAQ-100 Ex-Technology Sector Index Fund (QQXT), an ETF that allows investors to gain exposure to the Nasdaq-100 without the heavy technology sector allocation. This fund offers diversification away from tech and communication services while still providing growth potential and has historically outperformed the S&P 500 with less volatility. QQXT is presented as a compelling option for investors seeking growth outside of traditional tech-heavy portfolios.

title: Researchers Develop Foldable Haptic Actuator for Mixed Reality Applications
summary: Researchers from the University of Chicago have developed "Touch&Fold," a foldable haptic feedback device designed for mixed reality. Worn on the fingernail, it allows users to experience touch with virtual objects and textures, then folds away when interacting with real-world objects. This innovative solution enables seamless interaction between virtual and physical environments, unlike other haptic devices on the market.

title: Karl Robb, Independent Board Member at EPAM and Ajax Systems — about Ukrainian tech market from a foreigner's perspective and preparing companies for IPOs
summary: Karl Robb, a veteran of the tech industry and an independent board member at EPAM and Ajax Systems, discusses his experiences in the Ukrainian tech market. He shares insights on how EPAM attracted major clients like Google and Microsoft, the challenges and strategies involved in preparing companies for IPOs based on EPAM's experience, and his vision for the future of the Ukrainian IT industry. Robb also explains why he joined Ajax Systems and offers advice for successful tech entrepreneurship, emphasizing problem-solving over technology-first approaches.

title: DG Khan Cement Company Case Study
summary: This case study details how DG Khan Cement Company (DGKCC), a major player in Pakistan's cement industry, partnered with NetApp to upgrade its storage infrastructure. Facing rapid data growth and the expansion of a third plant, DGKCC needed a scalable, efficient, and cost-effective solution. They implemented NetApp FAS2552 systems with Data ONTAP and SnapMirror for data replication and disaster recovery, improving data management and supporting mission-critical Oracle and Microsoft applications.

title: Woodside empowers all employees to build apps, boosts safety, increase productivity
summary: Woodside Energy, Australia's leading natural gas producer, has empowered its 3,500 employees to develop apps using Microsoft's Power Platform. This initiative has improved efficiency, automated manual processes, and boosted safety through apps managing tasks from shift handovers to cyclone response planning. The company has a governance structure in place for app development, balancing innovation with security and quality control.

title: Cloudera Enters into Definitive Agreement to be Acquired by Clayton, Dubilier & Rice and KKR for $5.3 Billion
summary: Cloudera announced it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Clayton, Dubilier & Rice ("CD&R") and KKR in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $5.3 billion. Shareholders will receive $16.00 per share, representing a 24% premium to the closing price as of May 28, 2021. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of 2021 and will result in Cloudera becoming a private company, aiming to accelerate its hybrid cloud leadership for analytics.

title: KKR, CD&R to take data analytics firm Cloudera private for $4.7 billion
summary: Private-equity firms KKR and Clayton Dubilier & Rice (CD&R) are set to acquire cloud-based data analytics company Cloudera for $4.7 billion, taking it private. Cloudera's shares jumped approximately 25% in premarket trading on news of the $16 per share all-cash offer. The deal includes a 30-day "go-shop" period allowing Cloudera to consider alternative offers and is expected to close in the second half of the year.

title: C3 AI & Shell: Reshaping Global Energy with AI
summary: C3 AI and Shell have renewed and expanded their strategic agreement for five years to accelerate the deployment of enterprise AI and machine learning applications. This collaboration aims to address reliability, asset integrity, and process optimization across Shell's businesses and the broader energy market. Both companies emphasize their commitment to driving cleaner energy and climate initiatives through scalable AI-based solutions.

title: Pledge to Flex: The Future of Work at SAP Is 100% Flexible and Trust Based
summary: SAP is implementing a "Pledge to Flex" initiative, establishing a 100% flexible and trust-based work model as the new norm. This approach allows employees to work from home, the office, or remotely with flexible schedules, empowering them to choose the best environment for their productivity and collaboration. The company emphasizes its commitment to an inclusive environment, sustainable office designs, and utilizing technology like SAP SuccessFactors and Qualtrics to support this new work style and maintain employee engagement.

title: KKR, CD&R take data analytics firm Cloudera private for $4.7 bln
summary: Private equity firms Clayton Dubilier & Rice LLC (CD&R) and KKR & Co (KKR.N) are taking cloud-based data analytics company Cloudera Inc (CLDR.N) private for $4.7 billion. Cloudera's shares jumped 23.9% following the announcement, nearing the offer price of $16 per share. The move is intended to help Cloudera transition more smoothly into hybrid cloud solutions without the pressure of quarterly reporting.

title: Qualcomm supplying new Snapdragon chips locally
summary: Qualcomm Inc. is expanding its presence in the computer market by supplying new Snapdragon processors for 5G-enabled laptops, partnering with local companies like Acer Inc. The company aims to challenge Intel Corp. and transfer mobile applications to laptops, targeting various tiers of notebooks. Qualcomm also revealed its acquisition of Nuvia Inc. for about US$1.4 billion, enhancing its CPU and technology design capabilities.

title: How Coca-Cola United Streamlined Freestyle Order Management
summary: Coca-Cola Bottling Company United partnered with Happiest Minds Technologies to streamline its Freestyle order management process using Microsoft Power Automate RPA bots. This digital transformation, built on Microsoft Azure and Power Platform, allowed the company to avoid hiring additional full-time employees and freed up existing CRM agents for other projects. The automated system orchestrates the entire order process from purchase order to reconciliation in SAP, securely accessing internal and external systems.

title: Morgan Stanley and Microsoft collaborate to accelerate cloud transformation - Source
summary: Morgan Stanley and Microsoft have announced a strategic cloud partnership to accelerate Morgan Stanley's digital transformation and advance innovation in the financial services industry. This collaboration will leverage Microsoft Azure and Morgan Stanley's engineering teams to develop new application infrastructure meeting key financial services requirements, improve employee and developer experiences, and transition workloads to Microsoft Azure. The partnership aims to enhance client services, increase developer effectiveness, and ensure stringent compliance and regulatory guidelines are met in the highly regulated financial sector.

title: Global talent shortage at 15-year-high: Report
summary: A new report reveals that nearly seven in 10 employers globally are struggling to find qualified workers for specific positions, marking a 15-year high. Operations, logistics, manufacturing, IT, and sales and marketing are among the most affected sectors. The ManpowerGroup survey of 42,000 employers across 43 countries indicates that accelerated digitization due to the pandemic has led many organizations to plan for increased or maintained hiring, despite the talent scarcity.

title: Morgan Stanley and Microsoft Collaborate to Accelerate Cloud Transformation
summary: Morgan Stanley and Microsoft have announced a strategic cloud partnership to accelerate Morgan Stanley's digital transformation and drive innovation in the financial services industry. This collaboration will leverage Microsoft Azure to modernize Morgan Stanley's IT environment, enhance client, employee, and developer experiences, and co-design new application infrastructure for financial services. The partnership aims to address the complex regulatory landscape and evolving customer needs within the financial sector, ensuring secure and scalable solutions.

title: Microsoft’s Irish subsidiary posted £220bn profit in single year | Tax havens
summary: Microsoft's Irish subsidiary, Microsoft Round Island One, recorded a profit of $315 billion (£222 billion) in a single year, which is nearly three-quarters of Ireland's GDP, despite having no employees other than directors. The company is resident for tax purposes in Bermuda, which has no corporation tax, allowing it to pay no tax on income. This news emerged as G7 finance ministers discussed global minimum corporate tax rates to combat multinational tax avoidance.

title: Force of nature: How the unstoppable Marc Benioff fueled Salesforce’s stratospheric rise
summary: Marc Benioff, cofounder and CEO of Salesforce, has driven his software company to remarkable growth, fueled by ambitious acquisitions like the $28 billion Slack deal. The article explores how Benioff utilizes his celebrity status and platforms to advocate for causes beyond business, such as homelessness and climate change, while navigating challenges like employee diversity concerns and investor skepticism regarding his acquisition strategy. Despite his unconventional approach, Benioff's relentless vision and ability to inspire continue to shape Salesforce's trajectory and influence the tech industry.

title: SharpPanda: Chinese APT Group Targets Southeast Asian Government With Previously Unknown Backdoor
summary: Check Point Research uncovered a sophisticated surveillance operation by a Chinese APT group targeting a Southeast Asian government. The attackers employ spear-phishing and old Microsoft Office vulnerabilities to deploy a new backdoor, `VictoryDll_x86.dll`, capable of extensive system control and data exfiltration. The report details the multi-stage infection chain, the backdoor's capabilities, how it evolved from older test versions (`MClient`), and attributes the activity to a Chinese threat group based on TTPs and operational hours.

title: DLocal raises $75M in IPO, spearheads emerging markets
summary: DLocal, a cross-border payments company, successfully raised $75 million in its initial public offering, with most shares sold by existing stockholders. The company's stock jumped 54% on its first day, increasing its valuation to $9 billion. DLocal specializes in providing local payment methods and regulatory compliance for global merchants in emerging markets, a sector that saw significant growth during the pandemic.

title: Continued Funding From Congress Key For Government Cybersecurity, Expert Says
summary: A federal cybersecurity expert emphasized that continued investment from Congress is crucial for fortifying government cybersecurity. This is due to the increasing sophistication of cyber threats targeting American businesses and government systems. The expert noted that a multi-layered approach, rather than a single technology, is required to secure these systems and address the ongoing challenges posed by malicious cyber actors.

title: WAAS-Up with Cryptojacking Microservice-Based Web Apps?
summary: This article details a real cryptojacking attack against a microservice-based web application running on Kubernetes. The attacker leveraged a vulnerability to gain OS command privileges, download a coin miner binary, and consume compute resources for cryptocurrency mining. The author recounts the investigation, step-by-step attack, and explains how Prisma Cloud Compute Runtime Defence and the Web Application & API Security (WAAS) module could have prevented the incident.

title: Media and data firm Thomson Reuters faces pressure to ditch Ice contracts
summary: Thomson Reuters is facing increased pressure from shareholders and advocacy groups to terminate its contracts with US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (Ice) due to human rights concerns. Critics argue that the company's data-providing software, Clear, facilitates the tracking and deportation of immigrants. A shareholder resolution calling for an assessment of human rights impacts related to its Ice contracts will be voted on, despite opposition from the company's board of directors.

title: Tech Moves: Ex-Microsoft COO Kevin Turner leaves Core Scientific; Magic AI founder joins ThruWave
summary: Former Microsoft COO Kevin Turner has stepped down as CEO of blockchain startup Core Scientific, citing good timing as the company prepares to go public, and will remain an advisor. Additionally, Magic AI co-founder Alexa Anthony has joined ThruWave as business operations manager, bringing her experience in AI and hardware to the millimeter-wave technology company. The article also covers other notable personnel changes in the Pacific Northwest tech community, including new board members and executive hires.

title: Campbell Soup Company: Greater Disclosure of Material Corporate Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Data
summary: Shareholders are requesting that Campbell Soup Company report on the effectiveness of its diversity, equity, and inclusion efforts using quantitative metrics for recruitment, retention, and promotion. The resolution highlights the lack of publicly available data from Campbell's, specifically the consolidated EEO-1 form and inclusion data, which prevents investors from fully assessing the company's human capital management related to workplace diversity. The request emphasizes the investor demand for greater transparency in workplace equity data, citing previous investor statements and the practices of other S&P100 companies.

title: Microsoft wins U.S. antitrust okay for $16 bln purchase of Nuance
summary: Microsoft has received U.S. antitrust approval for its $16 billion acquisition of Nuance Communications, an artificial intelligence and speech technology company. The deal, announced in April, followed a 2019 partnership between the companies to automate healthcare administrative tasks. While U.S. regulatory hurdles have been cleared, the acquisition still requires approval from other jurisdictions and is expected to close by the end of 2021.

title: Q2 Appoints New Chief Revenue Officer
summary: Q2 Holdings, Inc. announced the appointment of Mike Volanoski as its new Chief Revenue Officer (CRO) for North America. Volanoski brings over 25 years of experience from companies like SAP and Microsoft, and will be responsible for driving Q2's growth strategy and new customer acquisition. Matt Flake, Q2 CEO, highlighted Volanoski's expertise in building world-class sales organizations and fostering relationships.

title: US legaltech provider Intapp files for potential initial public offering
summary: Intapp, a US cloud-based professional services software firm, is preparing for an initial public offering (IPO) on the Nasdaq Global Market under the ticker symbol “INTA”. The company, which specializes in client lifecycle software and serves 96 of the AM Law 100 firms, reported $187 million in total revenues for the 2020 fiscal year. Shearman & Sterling is advising Intapp on the IPO, while Latham & Watkins is advising the underwriters.

title: Key Takeaways: 2021 Magic Quadrant for Workforce Engagement Management
summary: Gartner's 2021 Magic Quadrant for Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) evaluates seven key vendors, noting that WEM technologies are crucial for increasing employee engagement, especially with the rise of remote work. NICE and Verint are recognized as leaders, while Calabrio, Genesys, and Aspect Software are visionaries. Eleveo and Lifesize are identified as niche players.

title: Oracle shows off more ‘Always Free’ cloud resources for developers
summary: Oracle has significantly expanded its "Always Free" cloud services for developers, adding 13 new offerings to its Oracle Cloud Infrastructure platform, bringing the total to 20. These free resources aim to attract developers to OCI by allowing them to experiment with services, including the new Arm-based Ampere A1 Compute, Oracle JSON Database, NoSQL Database Cloud Service, and low-code application development tools. This expansion positions Oracle more competitively against rivals like AWS and Google Cloud by providing substantial free tiers for building and testing end-to-end applications.

title: The Great Acceleration: Can Your Business Keep Up?
summary: The article discusses the "acceleration gap" faced by businesses, where the pace of change outstrips an organization's ability to capitalize on new opportunities. It identifies seven imperatives for businesses to thrive in the "next normal," emphasizing continuous recalibration, unified data, and agile processes. The author introduces the concept of an "enterprise management cloud" as a solution to this gap, highlighting Workday's approach to customer and employee satisfaction.

title: Dell announces new AMD-based Integrated Systems for Azure Stack HCI
summary: Dell Technologies Inc. has launched new AMD-based configurations for its Dell EMC Integrated Systems for Microsoft Azure Stack HCI, designed to handle more complex workloads and offer enhanced performance. These systems feature AMD EPYC 2nd generation CPUs and incorporate advanced security features from both AMD and Dell. Additionally, software updates aim to simplify provisioning and delivery tasks for IT engineers by pre-installing the Azure Stack HCI operating system and integrating OpenManage software with Microsoft Windows Admin Center.

title: VERB Management to Discuss Company’s Application Solutions
summary: Verb Technology Company, Inc. announced that its CEO and CFO will discuss the company's application solutions for the livestream ecommerce market at an A.G.P. Tech Talk webinar on June 10, 2021. The discussion will cover the growth of livestream ecommerce, the upcoming integration of VERB's video sales technology with Microsoft Outlook, and the company's strong Q1 2021 financial performance, including 38% year-over-year SaaS recurring revenue growth. This webinar aims to highlight VERB's position to capitalize on the growing livestream ecommerce market with its interactive video sales enablement SaaS applications.

title: Cybersecurity startup Brinqa raises $110 mln from Insight Partners
summary: Cybersecurity startup Brinqa, which helps businesses identify and remediate cybersecurity vulnerabilities, announced it raised $110 million from private equity firm Insight Partners. This marks the company's first institutional investment since its founding in 2009, driven by an increased demand for cybersecurity solutions due to remote work and a rise in digital gadgets. CEO Amad Fida stated that Brinqa's software can correlate data from numerous systems to identify and even automatically close security gaps, addressing the critical shortage of cybersecurity talent.

title: Israel researchers find four security flaws in Microsoft Office software
summary: Cybersecurity researchers at Check Point Software Technologies have identified four vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office software, including Excel and Office. These flaws, stemming from legacy code in a graph-making feature, could allow hackers to inject malicious code, take control of computers, or launch ransomware attacks. Users are urged to update their software immediately, as Microsoft has already fixed the reported issues.

title: How Microsoft is reimagining meetings for hybrid work
summary: Microsoft is transforming its internal meeting experiences for hybrid work by redesigning physical and virtual spaces and leveraging Microsoft Teams. The company identified key trends like employees evaluating their "worth it" equation for commuting and the need for leaders to make the office commute-worthy. Through prototyping in "the Hive," Microsoft developed an innovative meeting room experience that puts all participants, remote and in-person, on equal footing, enabling seamless collaboration for its employees and customers.

title: Fuzzing the Office Ecosystem
summary: Check Point Research fuzzed the MSGraph COM component within Microsoft Office, leading to the discovery of four vulnerabilities (CVE-2021-31179, CVE-2021-31174, CVE-2021-31178, CVE-2021-31939). These bugs affect multiple Microsoft Office products, including Excel and Office Online. The research highlighted the challenges of fuzzing complex graybox targets and evaluated various dynamic binary instrumentation (DBI) solutions, ultimately finding success with Jackalope.

title: Cisco to launch new features for Webex
summary: Cisco Systems Inc announced new features for its Webex platform, including background noise cancellation, polls, and quizzes, to enhance interactivity for hybrid work. The company has added 800 new features since September and is offering its new hybrid work suite at a 40% discount compared to a la carte options. These updates leverage machine learning and AI to improve virtual meeting engagement as remote work continues to be prevalent due to the pandemic.

title: NetApp Simplifies and Accelerates the Journey to Hybrid Cloud
summary: NetApp has released new ONTAP software and hybrid cloud portfolio enhancements designed to reduce costs, complexity, and unify data management across on-premises and public cloud environments. The updates provide flexible foundations for hybrid cloud, simplify data management, and offer cloud-like financial flexibility through services like the NetApp Keystone Flex Subscription at Equinix. These innovations aim to help enterprises modernize their IT, manage data, and accelerate their digital transformation journeys.

title: New CSPM Functionality Frees Teams from Alert Noise and Blind Spots
summary: Palo Alto Networks has introduced new Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) functionality within Prisma Cloud to enhance cloud security by reducing alert noise and blind spots. The update includes features like true internet exposure visibility, visibility-as-code, network data exfiltration detection, anomalous compute provisioning detection, and customizable object-level scanning for AWS S3. These enhancements aim to provide deeper context for incidents, eliminate vague alerts, and improve threat detection for complex cloud architectures.

title: Oilserv leverages SAP S/4HANA to empower data-driven decision-making
summary: Oilserv, a leading Nigerian oil and gas services company, has implemented SAP S/4HANA to achieve end-to-end business transformation and improve operational efficiency. The upgrade, hosted on Microsoft Azure, provides real-time data visibility and enhanced project management capabilities through SAP Commercial Project Management. This move allows Oilserv to make data-driven decisions and establish a strong foundation for future growth in the data-driven economy.

title: Big Data Technology Market to Rise at 14% CAGR till 2027; Growing Internet Penetration will Provide Impetus to Market Growth, says Fortune Business Insights™
summary: The global big data technology market is projected to reach USD 116.07 billion by 2027, growing at a CAGR of 14.0% from USD 41.33 billion in 2019. This growth is driven by increasing internet penetration, adoption of cloud-based platforms, and integration of AI and machine learning. While the COVID-19 pandemic has created mixed fortunes, with increased online data due to remote work, challenges like workforce shortages and budget constraints exist.

title: Battlefield 2042 preorder: Editions, bonuses, and where to buy
summary: Electronic Arts has revealed details for Battlefield 2042, set to launch on October 22 across multiple platforms. The article outlines the Standard, Gold, and Ultimate editions, detailing their respective bonuses like early access, in-game items, and the Year 1 Pass. It also notes pricing differences between PC and console versions, as well as cross-generational bundles for upgrading systems.

title: Securing Hybrid Cloud Containerized Workloads in AWS ECS Anywhere with SentinelOne Singularity
summary: SentinelOne announced Day 1 support for AWS's Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) Anywhere, extending its Singularity Cloud Workload Security to hybrid cloud environments. This integration allows organizations to secure containerized workloads running on-premises and in AWS with SentinelOne's AI-driven protection, detection, and response capabilities. The solution aims to provide consistent operational models and elastic scalability for hybrid cloud deployments.

title: NetApp brings ONTAP updates to simplify hybrid Cloud Data Management
summary: NetApp has updated its ONTAP data management software to enhance features and simplify hybrid cloud data administration. This move aligns with NetApp's "cloud-first" strategy, aiming to unify managing public and on-premises cloud environments for better data access. The updates are expected to simplify storage procedures, improve management ease for IT administrators, and enhance overall performance and data protection capabilities.

title: Simplifying Identity-Based Security in a Cloud-First World
summary: Palo Alto Networks has introduced the Cloud Identity Engine to simplify identity-based security in a cloud-first world, addressing the challenge of fragmented identity stores across on-premises and cloud environments. This new cloud-based architecture aims to provide consistent authentication and authorization for users, regardless of where their identity resides, enhancing Zero Trust adoption. It also enables instant multi-factor authentication for data center applications using existing cloud identity providers.

title: Zoom and Salesforce make quick $23 million profit after IPO of Israeli software vendor Monday.com
summary: Zoom and Salesforce each invested $75 million into Monday.com's IPO, quickly realizing a combined profit of $23 million as the stock jumped 15% on its debut day. This investment strategy is part of a larger trend for Salesforce Ventures, which has yielded significant gains from other IPOs like Snowflake, while Zoom is also beginning to use investments as a new business venture. Both companies are subject to a 180-day lock-up period before they can sell their shares.

title: Sify Technologies recognized in 2020 Gartner Market Guide for Public Cloud Managed and Professional Services Providers, Asia/Pacific
summary: Sify Technologies Limited has been recognized in Gartner's 2020 Market Guide for Public Cloud Managed and Professional Services Providers in Asia/Pacific. This recognition highlights Sify's industry-leading cloud capabilities and its role as a key partner for enterprises in their cloud transformation goals across the diverse Asia Pacific region. The company emphasizes its cloud@core philosophy and integrated solutions for digital objectives and its contribution to APAC's digital evolution.

title: EA: Gaming giant hacked and source code stolen
summary: Electronic Arts (EA) has confirmed that hackers stole source code for games like FIFA 21 and its Frostbite engine, with approximately 780GB of data compromised. The company assured that no player data was accessed and believes there is no risk to player privacy. EA stated that security has been improved and that they do not expect an impact on their games or business.

title: AMD: Enterprise Server Sales Will Catch Up With Overall EPYC Growth
summary: AMD expects its EPYC server processor sales to enterprise customers to soon match the growth rate of its overall server CPU business, which doubled last year. Dan McNamara, head of AMD's EPYC business, highlighted that the company is gaining trust with CIOs and expanding its footprint with hyperscalers for internal workloads. This growth is driven by modernizing data centers, AMD's focus on solutions, and platform support from major OEMs, enabling AMD to better compete with Intel.

title: Department of Health Data Collect Dashboards Enables Real-Time Monitoring of COVID-19 Response Across the Philippines
summary: The Philippine Department of Health (DOH) has upgraded its "DOH Data Collect (DDC) Dashboards" with the assistance of Info Alchemy Corporation and Microsoft, to provide real-time information on COVID-19 metrics such as bed capacity, supplies, and vaccine administration. This enhancement was crucial due to the surge in COVID-19 cases and aims to improve decision-making and data visibility for LGUs and health facilities. The new system leverages Microsoft Power BI to offer interactive reports and deeper insights, supporting the country's resilience and economic recovery efforts.

title: Tableau's new CEO Mark Nelson on life inside Salesforce, and the company's future in Seattle
summary: Mark Nelson, the new CEO of Tableau Software, discusses the company's performance post-acquisition by Salesforce and its role within the larger enterprise technology landscape. He highlights Tableau's revenue growth, its collaboration with Salesforce in customer deals, and its continued commitment to Seattle as a key operational hub. Nelson also touches upon Tableau's competitive position against Microsoft and offers advice to Slack's CEO on integrating with Salesforce.

title: Telkom Bangun Pusat Data Terbesar, Dirut Ririek: Ciptakan Pengalaman Digital Terbaik
summary: PT Telkom Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is nearing completion of its HyperScale Data Center (HDC), poised to be the largest in Indonesia. This development signifies Telkom's ambition to become a leading digital telecommunications company globally and a major player in digital platforms. The HDC is designed to accelerate digital platform businesses by enabling various ICT services for a wide range of clients from finance to government and global cloud providers.

title: Vertical Aerospace to go public in $2.2 billion SPAC deal
summary: Vertical Aerospace, an eVTOL aircraft maker, is set to go public through a merger with a blank-check firm in a deal valued at $2.2 billion. The company has secured pre-orders for up to 1,000 aircraft from customers like American Airlines and Avolon, totaling up to $4 billion. This move reflects a growing investment in zero-emission electric aircraft amid pressure for the aviation sector to decarbonize.

title: Palo Alto Networks Enhances Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM)
summary: Palo Alto Networks has updated its Prisma Cloud solution for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) to help organizations eliminate cybersecurity blind spots and guard against alert fatigue. These enhancements include True Internet Exposure, Visibility-as-Code, Network Data Exfiltration Detection, Anomalous Compute Provisioning Detection, and Customizable Object-Level Scanning for AWS S3. The CSPM market is experiencing significant growth, with revenues projected to reach $9 billion by 2026, driven by the high susceptibility of organizations to security breaches due to cloud misconfigurations.

title: Latham & Watkins Advises Vertical Aerospace on US$2.2 billion De-SPAC
summary: Latham & Watkins advised Vertical Aerospace, a UK-headquartered engineering firm specializing in electric vertical take-off and landing aircraft, on its business combination with Broadstone Acquisition Corp. This transaction, valuing Vertical at approximately US$2.2 billion, will lead to its listing on the New York Stock Exchange. The deal also includes significant investments from American Airlines, Avolon, Honeywell, Rolls-Royce, Microsoft’s M12, 40 North, and Rocket Internet SE, alongside commercial partnerships and pre-orders for up to 1,000 aircraft.

title: How to speed up deep learning model training in the automotive sector
summary: This article discusses a solution developed by Run:AI, Microsoft, and NetApp to accelerate deep learning model training in the automotive sector, specifically for lane detection. The solution leverages Azure NetApp Files, Azure Kubernetes Service, and Run:AI's platform to optimize GPU utilization and manage massive datasets efficiently in the cloud. This collaboration allowed for faster experimentation, reduced training costs, and improved data sharing among data science teams.

title: Microsoft’s Guns Blazing Starlink Support Can Deal Michael Dell’s RS Access Serious Blow
summary: Microsoft has publicly backed SpaceX's Starlink in a dispute over the 12GHz spectrum with terrestrial 5G operators like Michael Dell's RS Access LLC. Microsoft argues against reallocating the 12GHz band to MVDDS providers, asserting it would hinder broadband deployment in remote areas and deter investment due to a lack of international harmonization for terrestrial 5G use in that band. The company emphasized that satellite services are crucial for internet access in hard-to-reach locations.

title: Understanding Ribbon Connect for Microsoft Teams Direct Routing
summary: This article examines Ribbon Connect for Microsoft Teams Direct Routing, a cloud-based service enabling hybrid telephony scenarios where users connect to both a PBX and Microsoft Teams Phone System. It details how the solution facilitates seamless call transfers and presence integration between these systems, addressing challenges for organizations that cannot fully migrate from their PBX. The article compares Ribbon Connect's architecture to traditional direct routing, highlighting its ability to preserve PBX functionalities while integrating Teams.

title: Avolon and Vertical Aerospace: World’s Largest eVTOL Aircraft Order
summary: Avolon, an international aircraft leasing company, and Vertical Aerospace announced a groundbreaking US$2 billion order for up to 500 electric eVTOL aircraft (VA-X4). This agreement will introduce the ultra-short-haul aircraft category to commercial aviation with zero-emission aircraft capable of traveling over 200 mph and carrying four passengers plus a pilot. Avolon-e, a newly formed affiliate, will become a launch customer, with deliveries expected to begin in late 2024, highlighting Avolon's commitment to sustainability and the electrification of air transport.

title: Jessica Ashooh: The taming of Reddit and the National Security State Plant tabbed to do it
summary: The article discusses the controversial appointment of foreign policy hawk Jessica Ashooh as Reddit's Director of Policy in 2017. It highlights her background at the Atlantic Council and the UAE Ministry of Foreign Affairs, detailing her hawkish stances on Middle Eastern foreign policy, particularly regarding Syria. The author suggests her appointment is part of a broader trend of national security state influence over social media platforms, aiming to control content and narratives.

title: Dimensional U.S. Core Equity 2 ETF ETF Price, Holdings, & News (NYSEARCA:DFAC)
summary: This article provides details on the Dimensional U.S. Core Equity 2 ETF (NYSEARCA:DFAC), an exchange-traded fund that invests in U.S. equities with a tilt towards small-cap companies. summary: Parsons Government Services in Huntsville, Alabama, has been awarded a competitive cost-plus-fixed-fee level-of-effort contract worth over $2.2 billion by the Missile Defense Agency. summary: Aldevron, a Fargo-based biotechnology company specializing in plasmid DNA, mRNA, and proteins, is being acquired by Danaher Corp. for $9.6 billion. This acquisition will allow Aldevron to accelerate its development of genomic therapies and vaccines, while operating as a standalone company within Danaher's life sciences segment. This recognition underscores their success in leveraging the Microsoft platform to drive innovation and transformation for clients globally.

summary: Microsoft has appointed CEO Satya Nadella as its new chairman, marking the first time in over two decades that the roles of CEO and chairman are held by the same person, a move last seen before Bill Gates stepped down as CEO in 2000. Nadella, who became CEO in 2014, has been credited with significantly transforming Microsoft's business through strategic acquisitions and growth in its cloud services. John Thompson, whom Nadella succeeded as chairman, will now serve as the lead independent director.

summary: AudioCodes has released its Virtual Direct Routing Survivable Branch Appliance (DR-SBA), which can be deployed on VMware and Hyper-V platforms. title: IonQ quantum computing systems available through Google Cloud
summary: IonQ, a quantum computing startup, is making its 11-qubit and soon its 32-qubit quantum hardware accessible to customers via Google Cloud Marketplace. This partnership marks IonQ as the first quantum computer available on GCP, pre-dating Google's own hardware offerings, and expands the reach of quantum computing to a broader developer base. title: Bill Gates Says Every Leader Should Read This Book This Summer
summary: Bill Gates recommends "Lights Out: Pride, Delusion, and the Fall of General Electric" as essential summer reading for leaders. The book, written by Wall Street Journal reporters, details GE's decline, offering cautionary lessons on leadership, particularly regarding the dangers of fixating on short-term profits. Gates emphasizes that focusing solely on quarterly earnings can lead to systemic weaknesses, contrasting GE's approach with companies like Amazon and Tesla that prioritized long-term growth over immediate analyst expectations.

title: GM Stock Value Drops 4 Percent During Week Of June 14 – June 18, 2021
summary: General Motors (GM) stock value decreased by 4.44 percent during the week of June 14-18, 2021, closing at $58.76 per share. Factors influencing the stock include continued microchip shortage issues, production cuts, and the company's aggressive pivot towards electric vehicles and autonomous driving technologies.

summary: Since taking the helm in 2018, LG Group Chairman Koo Kwang-mo has implemented a "choice and concentration" strategy, divesting underperforming businesses and focusing resources on core growth areas. This initiative marks a significant step in the private sector's pursuit of nuclear fusion, historically government-funded, aiming to make it economically viable.

summary: In 2021, S&P 500 ETFs with alternative weighting methodologies, such as reverse market cap (YPS) and equal weight (RSP), began outperforming the traditional market-cap-weighted SPDR S&P 500 Trust (SPY). While alternative strategies show short-term gains, SPY maintains long-term outperformance and significant cost advantages due to its size and liquidity.

title: Microsoft challenges Apple's business model with new Windows 11 operating system
summary: Microsoft unveiled Windows 11, its first major operating system update since 2015, which directly challenges Apple's lucrative App Store model. The new Windows Store will allow developers to use their own in-app payment systems without commissions and enable Android apps to run on Windows PCs. This move contrasts sharply with Apple's "walled garden" approach and also competes with Google Play Store's commission structure, signaling a significant shift in Microsoft's strategy to attract developers and consumers.
